hero.title: Cultural Programs
hero.subtitle: Celebrating Tamil Heritage Through Arts
hero.description: Join us in preserving and promoting traditional Tamil cultural arts through our comprehensive programs for all ages.

children.text: Our cultural programs are designed to preserve, promote, and celebrate the rich traditions of Tamil culture. We offer a wide range of activities including traditional dance, music, and arts programs for all age groups.
Whether you're interested in learning Bharatanatyam, Carnatic music, or traditional Tamil arts and crafts, we have programs tailored to your interests and skill level.

cards.title: Bharatanatyam Dance
cards.description: Classical Tamil dance classes for beginners to advanced levels, taught by experienced instructors.

cards.title: Carnatic Music
cards.description: Learn traditional South Indian classical music with our expert vocal and instrumental teachers.

cards.title: Tamil Folk Arts
cards.description: Explore traditional Tamil folk dance, music, and cultural practices.

cards.title: Arts & Crafts
cards.description: Traditional Tamil arts including Kolam, painting, and handicrafts workshops.

content_sections.title: Join Our Cultural Programs Today
content_sections.description: Register now for our upcoming cultural programs and become part of our vibrant community.
